messages.content: Execute the acquired source-interpretation checks. Focus identifies the assertion being interpreted; other units are context, not additional effects attributable to focus. Judge each acquired PROBE PROPOSITION, which may differ from the candidate interpretation. Return supported/refuted, or unknown. Unknown/missing context is not false. For every definite judgment select actual supporting current unit IDs within that query window. These are fallible source judgments, not formal certificates. Follow the response schema exactly.

{"source_units": [{"id": 47, "text": "3 Return of confidential information Each party shall:"}, {"id": 50, "text": "(a) within one month of completion of the Purpose or receipt of a written request from the other party, return to the other party all documents and materials (and all copies thereof) containing the other party's Confidential Information and certify in writing to the other party that it has complied with the requirements of this sub-clause; and"}, {"id": 51, "text": "(b) notwithstanding completion of the Purpose or return of documents and materials as aforesaid, continue to be bound by the undertakings set out in clause 2."}], "checks": [{"query": {"id": "case_5:focus_express_disposal_action", "operation": "case_5:focus_express_disposal_action", "unit_ids": [47, 50, 51]}, "focus_unit_id": 51, "focus_unit": {"id": 51, "text": "(b) notwithstanding completion of the Purpose or return of documents and materials as aforesaid, continue to be bound by the undertakings set out in clause 2."}, "definition": {"name": "case_5:focus_express_disposal_action", "question": "Does the complete focus unit itself expressly require or authorize a return or destruction performance, certify completed destruction as an alternative, or impose a linked later return-or-destroy commitment? A heading, a retention permission alone, a reference to disposal, or continuing confidentiality is not support. If the focus is incomplete and the proposition cannot be resolved, answer unknown.", "choices": [{"name": "supported", "meaning": "The current source supports the acquired probe proposition."}, {"name": "refuted", "meaning": "The current source contradicts the acquired probe proposition.
